title: Instagram Stories in WhatsApp too!
excerpt: Instagram has started testing a new option!

runs.text: It looks like we will soon be able to share Instagram Stories straight into WhatsApp with a single click! What is good about that? Adding the option could drive more traffic to the service – not only growing the number of users (especially in countries where the messenger is number one) but also widening the use of Status in WhatsApp, which launched in February. A tie-up like this obviously has its downsides too. It is quick and easy to spot that after a while users get tired of the same content repeated across several channels.
So, do you like Facebook's new idea?
